changelog:
alibabacloud-elasticsearch-network-manage v0.0.2

- Added support for Kibana SSO authentication management.
- Updated installation instructions to require Aliyun CLI >= 3.3.3 and "AI-Mode" configuration.
- Enforced CLI user-agent requirements for all operations.
- Improved instance status checking logic, adding retry and clearer status handling.
- Enhanced network status pre-checks to avoid redundant operations.
- Documentation updates across references for new features and stricter security/init checks.
